name: Kiriyama Shizuka
source:
[b]The childish teacher.[/b]

Iori and Reona's homeroom teacher.
She is popular among students for her cute un-teacher-like appearance, and is doted on by everyone she meets.
When she gets upset, she pouts and throws tantrums, but that only makes people find her even more adorable.

[From [url=https://no-strike.jp/yuribatake/character-en/]Official Website[/url]]
